master.definition_en: Beriberi is a condition that occurs in people who are deficient in thiamine (vitamin B1). There are two major types of beriberi: wet beriberi which affects the cardiovascular system and dry beriberi which affects the nervous system. People with wet beriberi may experience increased heart rate, shortness of breath, and swelling of the lower legs. Signs and symptoms of dry beriberi include difficulty walking; loss of feeling in the hands and/or feet; paralysis of the lower legs; mental confusion; speech difficulty; pain; and/or vomiting. Beriberi is rare in the United States since many foods are now vitamin enriched; however, alcohol abuse, dialysis and taking high doses of diuretics increases the risk of developing the condition. In most cases,beriberi occurs sporadically in people with no family history of the condition. A rare condition known as genetic beriberi is inherited (passed down through families) and is associated with an inability to absorb thiamine from foods. Treatment generally includes thiamine supplementation, given by injection or taken by mouth.

curated.name_zh: 阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停综合征
aliases_zh: 睡眠呼吸暂停低通气综合征
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 夜间反复上气道塌陷导致间歇性低氧血症与交感神经过度激活，虽较少单次直接窒息死亡，但长期不治可显著诱发难治性高血压、夜间恶性心律失常/心源性猝死、急性心梗、脑卒中及重度疲劳驾驶交通事故。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 无创正压通气（CPAP呼吸机）联合减重、侧卧及口腔矫治器可完全消除夜间呼吸暂停与低氧，显著降低心脑血管事件与白天嗜睡；替尔泊肽（Tirzepatide）等新型减重降糖药亦获批用于肥胖相关中重度OSA。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: 国际死因统计将OSA归为心脑血管病及交通事故的隐形上游病因，未单列独立年度死亡人数；重度未治疗OSA患者全因及心血管死亡风险较常人升高约2–3倍。
annual_deaths_global.source: Benjafield et al., Lancet Respir Med 2019 / AASM

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国官方死因监测未单列OSA独立死亡数；但中国中重度OSA患者基数居全球首位，是高血压与夜间猝死的重要推手。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: Benjafield等（Lancet Respir Med 2019）估算全球30–69岁成人约9.36亿人患轻至重度OSA，其中约4.25亿人为中重度OSA（AHI≥15次/小时）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国30–69岁成人OSA患病人数位居全球第一（估算约1.76亿人患OSA，其中中重度OSA约6,600万人），男性、肥胖及下颌后缩人群高发。

肥胖者科学减重10%以上，戒酒（睡前饮酒加重上气道松弛）、停用镇静安眠药、采取侧卧位睡眠
下颌后缩或轻中度患者可定制口腔下颌前移矫治器（OA）；儿童OSA多因腺样体/扁桃体肥大引起，及时耳鼻喉科评估微创切除手术

clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 多导睡眠监测（PSG）单次约500–1,200元；主流国产/进口家用自动CPAP呼吸机一次性购置约3,000–8,000元（可使用5–8年），耗材面罩管路年更换约500–1,200元。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 2024年底FDA基于SURMOUNT-OSA III期试验批准GIP/GLP-1双激动剂替尔泊肽用于肥胖相关中重度OSA（呼吸暂停低通气指数AHI平均降幅达50%以上）; 2) 舌下神经电刺激植入装置（Inspire）及口服去甲肾上腺素/抗胆碱组合药物（AD109）在III期临床中为不耐受CPAP患者提供了无呼吸机治疗新方向。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 中国人群OSA知晓率与诊断率不足10%，大量患者把“响亮打呼噜”误认为睡得香; 2) 长期佩戴CPAP面罩的依从性偏低（约30%–50%患者中途放弃）; 3) 缺乏针对非肥胖、颅颌面解剖狭窄型OSA的口服有效药物。

master.definition_en: Familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency is a rare genetic disorder is which a person lacks the enzyme lipoprotein lipase, a protein needed to break down fat molecules. Deficiency of this enzyme prevents affected individuals from properly digesting certain fats. This results in the accumulation of fatty droplets called chylomicrons in the blood and an increase in the blood concentration of triglycerides. Symptoms include episodes of abdominal pain, recurrent inflammation of the pancreas (pancreatitis), abnormal enlargement of the liver and/or spleen (hepatosplenomegaly), and the development of skin lesions known as erruptive xanthomas. Familial lipoprotein lipase deficiency is caused by changes (mutations) in the LPL gene. It is inherited in an autosomal recessive pattern. Treatment aims to control symptoms and blood triglyceride levels with a very low-fat diet. Treatment for individual symptoms (i.e. pancreatitis) involves following established treatment guidelines.

master.definition_en: A rare condition that affects the nervous system. Signs and symptoms of the condition generally develop between ages 18 months and 8 years, although later onset cases have been reported. Affected people may experience loss of muscle coordination (ataxia), seizures that do not respond to medications, muscle twitches (myoclonus), visual impairment, and developmental regression (loss of previously acquired skills). It occurs predominantly in people of Portuguese, Indian, Pakistani, or Czech ancestry. CLN6-NCL is caused by changes (mutations) in the CLN6 gene and is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner. Treatment options are limited to therapies that can help relieve some of the symptoms.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 睡梦与突发危象的实时监测预警
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 在数分钟至数小时黄金窗到来前，提前发出异常信号

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

It’s important to note that these disorders can also have different genetic causes.
